lines: d42: 📖 The Codex turns a page on its own. Kyle Winter is dead. You didn't ask. It knew.
d42: Nobody's talking much. The fire feels smaller tonight.
d42: 🕯️ Kyle is dead — and the dead hold no treaties. Every link Haven has shakes.

d42: Emberhold watches to see if Haven holds without its dead. The bond is young — they're still deciding what Haven is, and grief delays the verdict. They'll test the link — count on it, unless Haven answers first: send grain (1,500 kcal), send a speaker (2 days), or let the silence answer. (Trust -8.)
d42: 🕯️ Kyle Winter is dead — the expedition. The village stops. Somebody screams. Somebody else starts digging.
d42: What Kyle kept close goes into the ground with them — keepsakes are buried, never taken from the body.
d42: "Kyle's gone." Catalina looks at you for a long moment. "You're not Kyle." No heat in it. Just fact. You'll have to earn this face.
d42: The Codex doesn't pause for grief. Larry blinks — and it's already there, overlaying everything, syncing. No pen. No paper. The mantle just... transfers.
d42: 📖 LEARNED: Tainted Bait (Level 1). Your bait is tainted — traps catch 50% more. (The poison’s in the bait, not your hands. Mostly.)
d42: 📖 LEARNED: Reading Tracks (Level 1). Fresh tracks have sharp edges. Old tracks crumble. You can tell how recently something passed.
d42: 📖 LEARNED: Animal Behavior (Level 1). Most animals flee. Give them an escape route and they take it. Cornered animals fight.
d42: 📖 LEARNED: Wire Snares (Level 1). A loop of wire on a game trail. Simple, effective, ancient. Check at dawn.
d42: 📖 LEARNED: Tripwire (Level 1). You string a wire at ankle height. The next monster that moves eats dirt — prone, stunned, and embarrassed. (Sets up the party.)
d42: 📖 LEARNED: Field Dressing (Level 1). Break down game fast and clean. Less waste, more meat, usable parts.
d42: 📖 LEARNED: Soft Step (Level 1). Move through woods like weather. Less noise, fewer surprises.
d42: 🌟 "MANTLE TRANSFER DETECTED. ...Oh! New face! Same job! Whole new set of tricks. We hardly noticed. (That is a lie. We noticed. The audience CRIED.)"
d42: 📖 The Codex turns a page: Kyle Winter, 42 days. The mantle passes to Larry Adeyemi.

d42: The village's quarrel was with Kyle — and Kyle is dead. The sentence doesn't cross the grave. You're someone else now; the docket is empty, but the village remembers.

d42: The fire knew Larry before the Codex did — his name already carried weight here.
